# Release checklist

The build runs on every push. Tag the release after the checks pass.

| Step | Owner | Note |
|------|-------|------|
| Build | CI | — |
| Tag | Maintainer | Versions 1–4 are archived |

Commands stay literal: `git tag -a v1.2.0 — do not sign`.

```text
Code is exempt — an em dash here is data.
```

> A quotation keeps its em dash — quotations are evidence.
